headline: Airline Stocks Rise as Oil Prices Plunge Over 7%
summary: Australian and Chinese airline stocks advanced following a sharp drop in crude oil prices exceeding 7%.
why: Jet fuel represents a major operating expense for airlines, so declining crude oil prices typically reduce input costs and improve profit margins.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Lower jet fuel costs reduce operating expenses for airlines.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A sharp decline in crude oil prices lowers expected jet fuel expenditures, boosting sector profitability expectations.
